scene.language: This scene describes a check scenario in soccer. There's an opponent, a coach, and a teammate. To create space for the teammate, the coach is gonna move or check in either direction at an angle and at a varying speed, and naturally the opponent will follow the coach. (light switch clicking)[0][1] The coach now has checked to an angle. The opponent has to follow the co- will naturally follow the coach, but depending on the distance from the coach to the opponent, the coach has two options. They can either pass it back to the teammate if there's tight pressure from the opponent, meaning the opponent is close by, or if the opponent is pretty far away, the coach can turn around and dribble forward. [2][3][4](light switch clicking) The coach has received the ball, but notice that the opponent is really close to the coach, so the- so the- the coach has no space to turn. In this case, the coach will pass it back to the teammate. [5][6][7](light switch clicking) This represents the check scenario. Now, notice the opponent is still drawn from the center to the coach. And now the other side of the field is open.
